cards.title: Chain of Command
cards.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You’re the headteacher. You should tell the parents I lost the class hamster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You’re its teacher. You tell them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can supply the facts. Bad news should come from a senior position.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I’ll appoint you deputy head for the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first recommendation is that we hear from the headteacher.

before.seedUse: Uses procedural routing from S67-single-a and the delegated bad-news opening from D101-single-a. The school and lost hamster are a new illustrative setting, not inherited source facts. B promotes A to remove the stated obstacle; A uses that promotion to route the same difficult announcement upward again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for a teaspoon must go through the kitchen supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're standing beside the teaspoons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Physical proximity is not authority.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the kitchen supervisor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then countersign your request. I'll pass it up to catering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I lend you this ladder, your department head must ask mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're neighbours, cleaning our gutters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to establish departmental boundaries.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just borrow it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while the gutter committee remains unformed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the organiser.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll ask why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you phone Mum and begin the conversation about selling the house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take over once you've said the word selling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the difficult word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I'll handle the words that come after it.

cards.title: Practical Realist
cards.instruction: Accept any unusual premise without debate. Focus immediately on schedules, costs, safety, and what must happen next.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, the ceiling predicts floods. Before discussing who broke the pipe, what's its maintenance budget?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you break the pipe?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First we need somewhere dry for its microphone. Prophecy carries poorly over running water.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're avoiding the question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm prioritising electrics. Who insured a talking ceiling against its own predictions?

before.seedUse: The talking ceiling and dragon retain unusual-premise acceptance; logistical questions explicitly divert from the damage or expense A is avoiding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the ceiling's talking, does it need a microphone for the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not surprised the ceiling talks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm concerned the people under the balcony won't hear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only speaks in prophecy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Can it predict the parking bill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your dragon can stay in the flat. Which meter measures its heating?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It breathes fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it pays the gas bill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It insists on being called Your Majesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that on the standing order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss the dent in your car, I've found a lovely garage café.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you hit a bollard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their scones are enormous. Shall I book a table?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does the booking need a mechanic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent question. Let's inspect their staffing over tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't read that letter yet. Have you noticed the new curtains?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says the rent's overdue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Think how much these curtains improve the room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How much did they cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that bird outside. Perfectly framed.

cards.title: Cleared to Know
cards.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the insider account of the party. Did the cake make it as far as the balcony?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do you know about the balcony?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I belong on the full briefing list. I'm checking how full it is.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We hadn't mentioned a balcony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then don't exclude me from the bit you haven't established yet.

before.seedUse: A uses insider entitlement to probe exactly how much is known, while B's questions threaten to expose A's suspiciously precise knowledge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me the unredacted reunion plan. I'm family, not the public.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That page lists everyone's surprise presents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Family should get more than the visitor edition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It includes your present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me who chose it. I should know who considers me family.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does my club briefing have blacked-out names?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the organising committee sees those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stacked every chair. Apparently my arms joined before the rest of me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can apply next month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I see the unredacted application, or is that intimate too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bit with the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before or after it reached the balcony?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened on the balcony?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing confirmed. Who's been using that word?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That they're missing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No mention of a drain, then?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should there be?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking how thorough the briefing was.

cards.title: Everything Is Policy
cards.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You always make tea after we argue. Shall we finish the reconciliation procedure before your taxi?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made the tea. We're done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tea initiates the procedure. Agreement closes it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What agreement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That you want tomorrow's tea with me too. Then I can authorise the taxi.

before.seedUse: The Stance turns ordinary recurring personal choices into policy; A uses this policy specifically to delay departure until repair is explicit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sat beside me at lunch. Shall I record that as our friendship policy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was the only empty chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So friendship is allocated by availability. Useful clarification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow I'll save you a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've moved from allocation to a reserved entitlement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised before making tea. Is that our conflict-resolution procedure now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knocked over your cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So material damage triggers refreshments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also felt bad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll add remorse as an optional supporting document.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The kitchen's spotless.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking about the people who cleaned it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What else needs doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sentence that lets me put my coat on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call the taxi yet. We haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We finished the conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We stopped talking. That's a different task.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're going to make us late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather arrive late than leave like this.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken charge of the broken-vase investigation. Questions require my approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is there glue on your hand?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved question. I'll appoint myself lead investigator of the glue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a piece of vase stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent work. You're promoted to observing other people while I preserve this evidence.

before.seedUse: A turns the exact culprit investigation into a status performance, claiming the authority to assess incriminating evidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You watered it with coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must investigate the coffee machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made the coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Conveniently, I know exactly where to begin.
